card.title: COLDSTREAM GUARDS
card.text: Deployment: Add a NAVAL SUPPORT to your hand.
card.flavorText: The Coldstream Guards are a part of the Guards Division of the British Army, and as the oldest regiment in the army it has participated in conflicts since the English Civil War in 1642. During WWII the battalions of the Coldstream Guards saw action in most theaters of the war. At the start of the war the 1st and 2nd battalions were part of the British Expeditionary Force in France, while the 3rd battalion was stationed in the Middle East. During the war two additional battalions were formed, the 4th and 5th, and they fought with the Guards Armored Division as dismounted infantry, first in North Africa and later in Europe. The 4th and 5th battalions were disbanded after the war.
